summary: Iteration-4 scoped retest: NEW public resources endpoints, member unarchive + trash members inclusion/scoping, seed idempotency for leader logins, /search archive exclusion (backend: 14/14 pytest passed) and UI verification of Guest header CTA, Guest Resources section + download, Trash Members tab restore flow (frontend: 100% of checked flows passed). No new defects found.
action_items: Optional robustness: Guest.jsx download sets a.href = data.file_data directly. If a resource was stored as raw base64 (no 'data:' prefix) the anchor becomes a relative URL and the download silently produces a broken/HTML file. Normalize to `data:${file_type};base64,...` when the prefix is missing (same applies to the authenticated Resources page).

Data hygiene (informational): 4 badges are still in Trash from earlier iterations ('Camping', 'Astronomy' seeded badges + 2 junk badges named 'scout'). Restore/purge them from the Trash UI so the public badge catalogue is complete.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1897 lines — beyond the 700-line guideline; split into routers (public, members, resources, admin) for maintainability.
GET /public/resources returns every non-archived resource (limit 500) with no pagination; fine for now but add limit/skip params before content grows.

ensure_seed_users_present() uses $setOnInsert only, so an existing seed user whose password was changed is NOT reset. This is intentional-ish (idempotent create) but means ADMIN_PASSWORD rotation will not propagate — document or add a password refresh path.
unarchive_member relies on _member_chapter_guard; verified 403 cross-chapter and 404 missing. Good.
seed_data_creation: Created and then hard-deleted: TEST_UI Handbook resource (data:text/plain base64), TEST_UI Archived Scout member, plus TEST_* members/badges/chapters/resources created inside pytest (all cleaned up via API + session cleanup fixture). Additionally restored 35 seeded members that earlier iterations had left in status='archived' (Members page previously showed only 1 member).

context_for_next_testing_agent: New pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_iter4_public_resources_unarchive.py covers: seed logins (incl. deleting sevan.leader from Mongo and re-running server.ensure_seed_users_present() -> user recreated with $2b$ bcrypt hash and login works), /public/resources list (no auth, no file_data, archived excluded), /public/resources/{rid} (file_data present, 404 archived/missing), member unarchive (national_admin, own-chapter chapter_admin 200, other-chapter 403, 404 missing), /trash members with chapter scoping, /search excluding archived member/badge/chapter. NOTE: DELETE /api/members only soft-archives; DELETE /api/badges and /api/chapters are HARD deletes (archive is POST /archive). Login response: access_token at top level. Chapters were renamed by the product owner (chp_ararat = 'Kentron Chapter', chp_sevan = 'Arabkir', chp_gyumri = 'Ajapnyak'), so do not assert chapter display names. Frontend verified on public URL with localStorage token 'scout_token'.
rca_of_the_issue: No product defect reproduced this iteration. Two initial pytest failures were test-authoring bugs on my side (login response is flat, not nested under 'user'; badge/chapter archive uses POST /archive not DELETE) and were fixed in the test file. The 'Members page shows 1 member' observation traced back to iteration-2/3 bulk-archive test pollution, not to this iteration's code; fixed by restoring status='active' on the 35 seeded members via Mongo.
